title: Recover a partial upgrade without repeating completed hosts
objectives: Recover a partial upgrade without repeating completed hosts
Refinement of the accepted AU-44–50 track; the original individual source was unavailable.

tasks.instruction: The retained six-host upgrade completed lm01, cm01, sh01 and idx01, then paused on a corrupted pending idx02 package. Inspect its actual version/service/phase history and original reviewed digests. Re-running a full install over completed hosts is not the recovery plan.

Use playbooks/v7_enterprise_repair.yml --limit idx02 to restore only the reviewed package descriptor and manifest from source and verify actual SHA-256. Review the retained paused job, then resume it through Enterprise maintenance and advance shared ticks until all six hosts verify 9.4.2.

Independently search index=source_logs | stats count and inspect the job; count=3. The recorded upgrade must retain the original pause/resume history and exactly one install per host. Configuration source must still match the original review.

hints: Inspect the original failure, target scope and active source before changing anything.
Verify native operational state independently of a playbook exit code.

references.purpose: On-change activation and explicit failed-handler recovery
Controlled upgrade order, artifact verification and health prerequisites

checks.label: Paused plan resumed without repeating completed hosts

feedback.success: Actual maintenance outcomes, preserved data and independent verification meet this lesson.
feedback.incomplete: Review current source, version, activation history and independent evidence.
